name: Metaphyseal Dysplasia-Maxillary Hypoplasia-Brachydactyly Syndrome
aliases: Metaphyseal Dysplasia with Maxillary Hypoplasia and Brachydactyly

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Clinical and Radiological Diagnostic Criteria for Metaphyseal Dysplasia-Maxillary Hypoplasia-Brachydactyly Syndrome

criteria.description: Radiological evidence of metaphyseal dysplasia characterized by irregular metaphyseal widening and sclerosis
Clinical presence of maxillary hypoplasia resulting in midface retrusion
Shortening of the digits (brachydactyly) confirmed clinically and radiographically
Postnatal growth retardation with short stature

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of all three major criteria: metaphyseal dysplasia on imaging, maxillary hypoplasia clinically, and brachydactyly confirmed clinically and radiographically
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Genetic testing may support diagnosis but is not currently definitive due to limited data.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Radiographic metaphyseal dysplasia with metaphyseal widening and sclerosis
searchTerms: x-ray shows widened and hardened bone ends
abnormal bone growth with thickened metaphyses
underdeveloped upper jaw causing flat midface
midface appears sunken due to small maxilla
short fingers due to small finger bones
shortened finger bones causing stubby fingers

common.symptomName: Short stature due to postnatal growth retardation
searchTerms: short height from slow growth after birth
postnatal growth delay
below average height due to growth retardation

common.symptomName: Delayed bone age on radiographic assessment
searchTerms: bones appear younger than actual age on X-ray
slow bone development seen on imaging
underdeveloped midface causing crooked teeth
midface bone smallness leading to dental misalignment

common.symptomName: Normal intelligence with absence of neurological deficits
searchTerms: normal thinking skills
no neurological problems
typical intelligence and brain function
slightly loose joints
mild joint flexibility

occasional.symptomName: Recurrent otitis media secondary to craniofacial abnormalities
searchTerms: repeated ear infections from facial bone shape
frequent middle ear infections due to craniofacial issues
slight hearing loss
mild difficulty hearing
minor conductive hearing impairment
late crawling or walking
delayed movement skills
slow motor development

rare.symptomName: Mild respiratory complications due to craniofacial structure
searchTerms: mild breathing problems from facial bone structure
slight respiratory issues related to face bones

laboratory: Normal routine blood tests; occasional mild anemia reported
imaging: Radiographs showing metaphyseal dysplasia with metaphyseal widening and sclerosis
Delayed bone age on hand/wrist X-rays
genetic: No definitive gene identified; suspected autosomal recessive inheritance pattern
other: Clinical examination revealing brachydactyly and midface retrusion

distinguishingFeatures: Isolated brachydactyly without metaphyseal dysplasia or maxillary hypoplasia
Dental abnormalities distinct from maxillary hypoplasia

redFlags: Severe growth retardation with respiratory compromise
Progressive skeletal deformities causing functional impairment
Signs of neurological deterioration or developmental delay
